env -u CODEX_HOME pnpm --filter @kaoiro/runner exec vitest run test/spawn.test.ts
env -u CODEX_HOME pnpm --filter @kaoiro/claude-code exec vitest run test/host.test.ts test/cli_sigterm_abort_real_process.test.ts -t 'filters CODEX_HOME|SDK child'
env -u CODEX_HOME pnpm --filter @kaoiro/claude-code exec vitest run test/host.test.ts -t 'filters CODEX_HOME'
env -u CODEX_HOME pnpm --filter @kaoiro/antigravity exec vitest run test/host.test.ts -t 'uses the configured executable through default child processes'

limitations: Claude Code evidence reaches real SDK child startup and the supplied SDK environment; Antigravity evidence reaches default OS child processes for discovery, hook registration, and a turn with a fixture executable. Native model-driven tool execution is unmeasured and deferred to director-owned post-deployment confirmation under the accepted scope decision.
All three authenticated Codex turns completed against the default ChatGPT provider using the scratch state home. No production credential was copied.
Hook bodies use the real model-profile hook and resolver with a disposable gpt-6 profile. Hooks were discovered and trusted with native hooks/list.
warnings: Claude SDK emits CLAUDE_SDK_CAN_USE_TOOL_SHADOWED for allowed tools in the real-process escalation test; that warning is unrelated to the environment boundary.
The deliberately bypassed preflight and deliberately removed home policies produce expected failures/canaries.
Positive native and authenticated Codex runs emit no unhandled errors or warnings.

director_scope_decision.decision: Pre-landing Claude Code and Antigravity gates are limited to real child-process boundaries and mutation evidence. Native tool execution is unmeasured and deferred until production deployment. Authenticated turns on these engines remain outside authorization.
director_scope_decision.remaining_confirmation: After landing issue 464 and updating the runner, ask a Claude Code peer and an Antigravity peer to run printenv CODEX_HOME once in their tool shells, requiring an empty value. Require a Codex peer tool shell to report its private isolated home.
